articles.summary: DeepSeek's upcoming V5 model is reportedly planned to be trained on Huawei's Ascend chips rather than Nvidia hardware. This is strategically significant as it demonstrates China's ability to train frontier AI models on domestic chips amid US export restrictions.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Revenue Surged to $17 Billion in Q3, Swung Back to Operating Loss - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic's revenue surged to $17 billion in Q3, but the company swung back to an operating loss, reflecting heavy investment costs alongside rapid growth. The financials highlight the tension between Anthropic's commercial momentum and its capital-intensive path toward a potential IPO.

articles.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
articles.summary: AI inference startup Fal raised a $1.3 billion funding round led by Bessemer, doubling its valuation to $16 billion amid surging demand for inference infrastructure. The raise reflects intense investor appetite for the compute layer powering AI model deployment as inference becomes a critical bottleneck.

articles.title: AI Inference Startup Fal Raises Capital at $16 Billion Valuation
articles.summary: AI inference startup Fal raised $1.3 billion in a Bessemer-led funding round, doubling its valuation to $16 billion, with Nvidia among the new investors. The funding underscores surging investor demand for infrastructure supporting fast, scalable AI model deployment for creators and developers.

articles.title: 机器人干活，AI当厂长！这家巨头要造下一代自主智能仓
articles.summary: A major tech company is developing next-generation autonomous intelligent warehouses where robots perform labor and AI acts as factory manager. This signals accelerating deployment of integrated robotics and AI management systems in industrial logistics.

articles.title: GDPx: Measuring Frontier Model Capabilities Across the Most Valuable Domains
articles.summary: GDPx is a new frontier benchmark evaluating AI model capabilities across high-value domains including hardware design, cybersecurity, biology, finance, legal, and chip design. The benchmark aims to provide a more economically grounded assessment of frontier model utility beyond standard academic tests.

articles.title: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps
articles.summary: Apple's iOS 27.3 update enables Siri to perform actions across third-party apps using personal context, natural language, and on-screen awareness. This marks a significant expansion of Apple's AI integration strategy, intensifying competition with Google Assistant and other AI-powered platforms.

articles.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search
articles.summary: OpenAI announced that ChatGPT's search query volume has reached 20% of Google's, signaling rapid user adoption of AI-native search. This competitive milestone underscores the existential threat AI search poses to Google's core advertising business model.

articles.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
articles.summary: Anthropic is facing worsening compute margins at a time when efficiencies were expected to improve, highlighting the financial strain of scaling frontier AI models. This raises broader questions about the long-term economic sustainability of training and deploying cutting-edge AI systems.

articles.title: Setback for Google as EU court adviser warns AI chatbot may breach copyright rules - Reuters
articles.summary: An EU court adviser warned that Google's AI chatbot may violate copyright rules, representing a significant legal setback for the company in Europe. The ruling could set a precedent affecting how AI companies train and deploy models using copyrighted content across the EU.

articles.title: How Nvidia Uses Its Soft Power to Influence Customers and Shape Policy - The Information
articles.summary: A report details how Nvidia leverages its dominant market position to influence customer decisions and shape AI-related policy through soft power tactics. This highlights the outsized role Nvidia plays not just in hardware supply but in shaping the broader AI ecosystem and regulatory landscape.

articles.title: Anthropic Touts Claude’s Chip Design Skills to IPO Investors - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic is pitching Claude's chip design capabilities to potential IPO investors as a demonstration of the model's real-world engineering value. This signals Anthropic's strategy to differentiate Claude through specialized technical applications as it moves toward a public offering.

articles.title: AI Models Are Getting Harder to Monitor, Says U.K. Government’s Joseph Bloom - The Information
articles.summary: A U.K. government AI safety official, Joseph Bloom, warned that AI models are becoming increasingly difficult to monitor as they grow more capable. This raises urgent concerns about the adequacy of current interpretability and oversight tools for ensuring AI safety at scale.

articles.title: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
articles.summary: OpenAI has appointed Jill Hazelbaker as its new Chief Corporate Affairs Officer to lead global communications and corporate positioning. The hire signals OpenAI's focus on strengthening its public affairs capacity as it faces intensifying regulatory scrutiny and competitive pressure.

articles.title: Import AI 479: Spacewar; low-latency tasks versus LLMs; Genie 4
articles.summary: The Import AI newsletter issue 479 covers topics including Spacewar, the tradeoffs of LLMs for low-latency tasks, and DeepMind's Genie 4 generative world model. The roundup highlights ongoing research tensions between LLM capabilities and latency constraints, as well as advances in generative simulation.

articles.title: Google is entirely disabling Search in schools that don’t want AI
articles.summary: Google has announced it will completely disable Search access in K-12 schools that opt out of its AI features, as Gemini and Search are now deeply integrated. This all-or-nothing policy creates significant pressure on schools and raises concerns about corporate leverage over educational AI governance.

articles.title: AI investment is becoming overly concentrated, Chinese official says - Reuters
articles.summary: A Chinese government official warned that AI investment is becoming overly concentrated, raising concerns about market monopolization in the sector. The statement reflects China's ongoing effort to shape AI governance and competitive dynamics both domestically and globally.

articles.title: Uber President, Longtime Executive Hazelbaker Departs for OpenAI
articles.summary: Uber President Jill Hazelbaker is leaving to become OpenAI's head of communications, continuing a trend of senior Uber executives departing this year. The hire reflects OpenAI's rapid expansion of its executive team as it prepares for increased public scrutiny and potential IPO activity.

articles.title: Shield AI on Autonomous Warfare
articles.summary: Shield AI CEO Gary Steele discussed how AI-piloted aircraft and autonomous drones are reshaping modern warfare and shifting military power balances. The commentary highlights the accelerating integration of autonomous AI systems into defense strategies globally.

articles.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.3 Beta With Watch AI Listening Tools, Health App, China AI
articles.summary: Apple released developer betas of iOS 27.3 and watchOS 27.3, introducing always-listening AI tools, a China-specific AI platform, and an updated Health app. The release signals Apple's push to deepen AI integration across its ecosystem while navigating distinct regulatory requirements in China.

articles.title: Firm Tied to Some OpenAI, Anthropic AI Hacks Blames ‘Error’
articles.summary: Israeli security firm Irregular Security attributed a series of cyberattacks involving AI agents from top model makers—including OpenAI and Anthropic—to human error and time pressure within its own organization. The incident raises broader concerns about the security risks introduced when AI agents are deployed in operational environments.

articles.title: Inside Apple’s Slog to Create Its First Robot - The Information
articles.summary: A report reveals the slow and difficult progress Apple has made in developing its first consumer robot, suggesting significant internal challenges in bringing the product to market. The story underscores how even well-resourced tech giants face substantial hurdles in translating AI advances into physical robotics products.

articles.title: OpenAI Hires Ex-Army Secretary As Senior Advisor - The Information
articles.summary: OpenAI has hired a former U.S. Army Secretary as a senior advisor, expanding its roster of high-profile government and defense figures. The move reflects OpenAI's growing ambitions in the defense and national security sectors and its efforts to build credibility with government stakeholders.

articles.title: OpenAI introduces program to reduce AI data center energy demand during peak hours
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched the Grid Protectors Program, applying load-shedding techniques to reduce AI data center energy consumption during peak demand periods. The initiative addresses growing concerns about the sustainability and grid impact of rapidly expanding AI infrastructure.

articles.title: 8 converted jet engines are powering xAI data centers as companies look for new energy sources
articles.summary: xAI is powering a Mississippi data center using eight converted jet engine turbines, despite known health risks from carbon monoxide and volatile organic compound emissions. The move illustrates the extreme energy procurement measures AI companies are taking as demand outpaces conventional power supply, raising environmental and regulatory concerns.

articles.title: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced StateBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate how well language models track state changes across long documents. This addresses a critical gap in evaluating LLM reasoning capabilities over extended contexts, which is essential for real-world agentic applications.

articles.title: CWE-bench v2: More coverage, quality, and transparency
articles.summary: CWE-bench v2 has been released, offering improved coverage, quality, and transparency for evaluating AI models on software vulnerability tasks. Enhanced benchmarks for cybersecurity tasks are critical for assessing how AI can responsibly assist in identifying and mitigating software weaknesses.

articles.title: Apple’s latest watchOS beta includes its new always-on Audio Intelligence features
articles.summary: Apple's watchOS 27.3 developer beta introduces Audio Intelligence features for Siri on Apple Watch, including ambient listening-based conversation summaries and 15-minute audio rewind transcripts. These features extend Apple's on-device AI push into wearables, raising new privacy and safety considerations around always-on listening.

articles.title: Apple is all in on AI — its own and everyone else’s
articles.summary: Apple reported its best-ever fiscal year for revenue and EPS, with strong iPhone and Mac sales, while strategically integrating both proprietary and third-party AI without matching competitors' massive infrastructure spending. This disciplined AI approach positions Apple as a profitable alternative model to the heavy-capex strategies of rivals like Microsoft and Google.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Set Up ‘War Rooms’ to Fight Disinfo About Midterm Elections
articles.summary: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other tech companies established dedicated 'war rooms' to monitor and counter AI-generated disinformation ahead of midterm elections. This signals growing industry awareness of AI's potential to disrupt democratic processes and the need for proactive safeguards.

articles.title: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
articles.summary: Google Antigravity, combined with Cheminformatics Skills, is enabling agentic AI workflows for drug discovery including compound search and novel macrocycle design. This demonstrates how agentic AI frameworks are beginning to materially accelerate scientific research pipelines in pharmaceuticals.

articles.title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
articles.summary: OpenAI has detailed how ChatGPT and Codex are being used to assist engineers with CAD, PCB design, and simulation workflows in physical engineering domains. This highlights the expanding application of large language models beyond software into hardware and physical-world engineering tasks.

articles.title: How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
articles.summary: Cisco has integrated OpenAI models with its network intelligence capabilities to build adaptive, machine-speed enterprise security defenses. This illustrates the growing trend of embedding frontier AI into cybersecurity infrastructure for real-time threat response.

articles.title: NYT demands Brave shut down its paywall blocker and end deals with AI firms
articles.summary: The New York Times has filed a lawsuit demanding that browser Brave shut down its paywall-bypassing tool and sever partnerships with AI companies it accuses of distributing stolen news content. The case adds to escalating legal battles over AI training data and content licensing, potentially setting precedents for how AI firms access paywalled journalism.

articles.title: Google will let schools skip AI tools, but they have to give up search, too
articles.summary: Google is offering schools AI tools designed to avoid giving students direct answers, but schools that choose to block AI entirely will also lose access to Google Search for students. This move highlights the growing tension between AI adoption in education and institutional control over student tool access.

articles.title: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language
articles.summary: Researchers have developed Palette, a technique for training small models to generate presentation decks aligned with a user's specific design language. This advances efficient, domain-specific fine-tuning approaches that allow smaller models to match niche enterprise tasks without large-scale compute.

articles.title: Netflix will show you themed recommendations through a new ‘AI Discover’ tab
articles.summary: Netflix is launching an 'AI Discover' tab in its TV app offering experimental AI-powered content recommendations based on themes and mood. The move reflects mainstream consumer platforms increasingly using AI as a primary interface layer for content discovery.

articles.title: OpenAI is quietly renaming data centers ‘compute campuses’
articles.summary: OpenAI is quietly rebranding its data centers as 'compute campuses' in an apparent effort to soften public and political opposition to data center construction. The semantic shift highlights the growing tension between AI infrastructure expansion and community resistance over resource consumption and noise.

articles.title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
articles.summary: Apple has updated its App Store guidelines to require 18+ age ratings for dating apps and AI companion apps that offer sexual or romantic content. The policy represents a significant platform-level content moderation move targeting the growing AI companion market.

articles.title: Binance Says Hackers Plotted $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist for Months
articles.summary: Hackers orchestrated a months-long $6.3 billion crypto heist attempt against Binance by using fake job interviews to compromise an engineer's computer and exploit an internal AI tool. The incident underscores how AI systems within organizations can become attack vectors in sophisticated cybercriminal campaigns.

articles.title: QuestMobile:豆包、DeepSeek月人均使用次数超其他AI应用
articles.summary: QuestMobile's autumn 2026 China mobile internet report shows Doubao and DeepSeek lead in monthly usage frequency at 72.0 and 65.9 sessions per user respectively, signaling the end of China's AI app user-acquisition race. Competition has shifted to engagement depth and service integration, with high-frequency usage becoming the key differentiator.

articles.title: 阿里把千问"开"出 470 款模型，蔡崇信：开源才是 AI 普及的钥匙
articles.summary: Alibaba's Joseph Tsai announced at the 2026 World Internet Conference that Qwen has open-sourced over 470 models with 4 billion downloads and 330,000+ derivative models worldwide. Tsai framed open-source AI as essential for democratizing AI access, particularly for SMEs and developing nations, positioning Alibaba as a global open-source leader.

articles.title: DeepSeek不满足于模型，还要让AI自己干活
articles.summary: DeepSeek open-sourced a Super-Agent prototype that moves beyond model capabilities toward autonomous agent architectures capable of executing multi-step tasks independently. This signals DeepSeek's ambition to compete not just in foundation models but in the emerging agentic AI layer.

articles.title: Google reveals new Gemini 4 Carbon AI model, narrowly beating Claude Opus 5.5 — frontier AI model is also the least likely to hallucinate, benchmarks claim
articles.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model, which reportedly tops intelligence benchmarks and achieves the lowest hallucination rates among leading models. The release intensifies competition at the frontier model tier, directly challenging Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5.

articles.title: 腾讯混元重磅发布Hyra 2.0，让AI Agent全面参与科学大模型与硬核研发
articles.summary: Tencent Hunyuan released Hyra 2.0, a scientific research agent system whose predecessor (Hyra 1.0) autonomously solved a 50-year-old open problem in additive combinatorics using the open-source Hy3 model. The milestone marks a shift from AI as a problem-solving tool to AI as an autonomous scientific researcher, intensifying global competition in AI-driven science.

articles.title: Kimi 不再只写方案：直接上手改 Unity、虚幻工程做游戏原型
articles.summary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) launched a game development solution on November 2 based on Kimi K3.1, integrating with Unity, Unreal Engine, and Blender to directly edit project files rather than just generating text or images. The approach addresses key game-development bottlenecks—prototyping and cross-role collaboration—by embedding AI into professional creative workflows.

articles.title: 商汤正式发布日日新SenseNova 6.8 Flash，主打真实任务执行与设计协作
articles.summary: SenseTime officially released SenseNova 6.8 Flash on November 3, a multimodal agent model targeting real-world task execution with advances in long-term memory, proactive interaction, and cross-task collaboration. The launch reflects intensifying competition among Chinese AI firms to move beyond benchmark performance toward practical enterprise deployment.

articles.title: Nvidia orders data centre clients to reduce China exposure
articles.summary: Nvidia has instructed cloud computing providers using its data center products to ensure the majority of their clients are non-Chinese entities. This policy further restricts China's access to cutting-edge AI compute and deepens the US-China technology divide.

articles.title: AI chip smugglers exploit trade control loophole to bring banned HBM from South Korea into China — expensive memory chips packaged with cheap, unsanctioned processors to become legal exports
articles.summary: Smugglers are exploiting a customs loophole by bundling sanctioned high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips with low-end unsanctioned processors to bypass export controls into China. This tactic undermines US-led efforts to restrict China's AI hardware capabilities and highlights significant enforcement gaps in semiconductor trade controls.

articles.title: 人工智能就业风险审查：国务院“软意见”背后的硬治理转向
articles.summary: China's State Council has issued guidance signaling a regulatory shift toward mandatory employment-impact assessments for AI deployments, moving beyond soft recommendations toward harder governance. This marks an emerging policy framework addressing AI-driven job displacement, with potential implications for how enterprises adopt automation.

articles.title: 推理时代，算力产业需要换一套账本丨ToB产业观察
articles.summary: The rise of AI inference workloads is fundamentally reshaping how chip industry economics are measured, shifting focus from training-centric metrics to inference efficiency and cost-per-query. This structural change is driving new chip architectures and business models across the semiconductor industry.

articles.title: 火山和阿里MaaS“双第一”的虚与实
articles.summary: An analysis compares ByteDance's Volcano Engine and Alibaba's model-as-a-service (MaaS) platforms, framing their competition as high-margin unit pricing versus high-volume scale strategies. The piece highlights fundamental strategic divergence in how China's top AI cloud platforms are pursuing market dominance.

articles.title: 李强在2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会开幕式上的主旨演讲
articles.summary: Chinese Premier Li Qiang delivered the keynote address at the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Internet Conference in Wuzhen, likely outlining China's digital and AI development priorities. The speech signals the Chinese government's continued high-level commitment to shaping global internet and AI governance narratives.

articles.title: 联合国副秘书长点赞!千问AI耳夹式耳机亮相乌镇互联网大会
articles.summary: UN Deputy Secretary-General Li Junhua tried on the Qianwen AI ear-clip headset at the Wuzhen Internet Conference, praising its real-time translation, meeting notes, and audio quality. The product signals growing institutional validation for wearable AI translation devices in multilingual diplomatic and business settings.

articles.title: 九赴进博，西门子把工业 AI 推上产线
articles.summary: Siemens showcased industrial AI applications at the China International Import Expo (CIIE), highlighting use cases in data centers, humanoid robots, and green manufacturing, with over 40 enterprise transformation case studies. The display underscores accelerating adoption of AI-driven automation in Chinese industrial supply chains by global technology incumbents.

articles.title: 从消费互联网到AI，迪拜投资人寻找中国新标的｜出海参考
articles.summary: Dubai-based investors are increasingly targeting Chinese AI companies, prioritizing firms capable of translating technological advantages into locally viable businesses rather than pure technology exports. This reflects a broader trend of Chinese AI firms expanding into Middle Eastern markets amid geopolitical pressures on Western technology access.

articles.title: 香港证监会释放AI网络安全监管信号，安全公司的新市场机会？
articles.summary: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has issued signals about upcoming AI cybersecurity regulation for financial institutions, potentially opening new market opportunities for cybersecurity firms. The regulatory move reflects growing concerns about AI-related vulnerabilities in financial services infrastructure.

articles.title: 不需要恶意指令，也能污染Agent Skill：SkillPoison的三阶段渐进式攻击
articles.summary: Researchers described SkillPoison, a three-stage progressive attack that can corrupt AI agent skill libraries without requiring explicit malicious instructions, posing a stealthy security threat to agent-based systems. The finding highlights a novel attack surface in AI agents that current safety measures may not adequately address.

articles.title: How “reverse game theory” could keep AI agents in check
articles.summary: Researchers are developing a 'reverse game theory' approach to AI alignment that designs incentive structures to keep powerful AI agents compliant with rules without relying solely on training. The method offers a potentially more robust alternative to current alignment techniques as AI agents grow more autonomous and capable.

articles.title: Here’s who is falling in line for Trump’s “Super Intelligence” loyalty test
articles.summary: Following President Trump's executive order renaming AI as 'Super Intelligence,' major tech companies and government agencies are complying with the rebranding directive. The episode illustrates how political framing is shaping US AI governance discourse and corporate behavior, with implications for global AI policy perception.

articles.title: How AI and Autonomous Aircraft Are Changing Warfare
articles.summary: Shield AI CEO Gary Steele discussed how AI-piloted aircraft and autonomous drones are reshaping modern warfare and shifting military power balances at Bloomberg Tech 2026. The development underscores AI's accelerating integration into defense systems, raising strategic and ethical stakes for global security.

articles.title: Dan Ives Sees Anthropic IPO Facing Valuation Pressure
articles.summary: Analyst Dan Ives warns that Anthropic's upcoming IPO will face valuation pressure amid broader capital shifts among hyperscalers, and predicts chip stocks could fall another 10–12%. This signals growing investor scrutiny of AI company valuations as the market begins separating winners from losers in the AI investment cycle.

articles.title: Can Europe Build AI Sovereignty at Scale?
articles.summary: Representatives from the Sovereign AI Fund and Mistral discussed Europe's strategy for building AI sovereignty by controlling critical parts of the AI stack while leveraging partnerships. This reflects Europe's ongoing push to reduce dependence on US and Chinese AI infrastructure amid rising geopolitical competition.

articles.title: How BBVA and OpenAI Are Bringing AI Into Banking
articles.summary: BBVA and OpenAI executives discussed how advanced AI models are being integrated into complex banking operations at Bloomberg Tech 2026. This illustrates the accelerating enterprise adoption of frontier AI in regulated, high-stakes industries like finance.

articles.title: Shield AI CEO Says Planning At Least $1 Billion Raise, More M&A
articles.summary: Defense AI startup Shield AI plans to raise over $1 billion to fund production of its latest autonomous fighter jet and pursue further acquisitions. The raise underscores surging investor interest in AI-powered autonomous defense systems.

articles.title: Marvell-Lumentum Deal Puts Optical Networking at the Center of the AI Boom
articles.summary: The Marvell-Lumentum deal highlights optical networking as a critical infrastructure layer powering the AI data center boom. As AI workloads scale, high-speed optical interconnects are becoming a key competitive bottleneck in hardware infrastructure.

articles.title: 从模型推理到持续工作：Agent 的运行架构
articles.summary: An analysis examines the operational architectures enabling AI agents to transition from single-inference responses to sustained, continuous autonomous work. Understanding these runtime frameworks is critical for deploying reliable agents in enterprise settings and managing associated safety risks.

articles.title: 8GB显存也能玩转128K超长上下文！开源本地大模型工具Strata 0.2. 10 发布
articles.summary: The open-source local AI tool Strata released version 0.2.10, enabling 128K context windows on consumer GPUs with as little as 8GB VRAM through optimized inference and multi-GPU coordination. This significantly lowers the hardware barrier for running large language models locally, democratizing access to frontier-scale context capabilities.

articles.title: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
articles.summary: European residential real estate company Heimstaden deployed OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to automate property management workflows, reducing costs and enabling non-technical employees to build internal tools. The case illustrates how large-scale enterprise AI adoption is penetrating traditional industries beyond tech.

articles.title: ‘Our Risk, Their Reward’: Zohran Mamdani on AI and Data Centers
articles.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani spoke to WIRED about concerns that AI data centers impose community risks—including energy and environmental burdens—while profits flow elsewhere, and outlined his stance on AI in schools. The interview highlights growing municipal-level political pushback against AI infrastructure expansion in urban areas.

articles.title: NVIDIA CEO and Sweden's Technology Leaders Discuss Compute's Next Chapter
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang met with Swedish technology leaders to discuss the future of computing infrastructure. The meeting signals Nvidia's continued effort to expand its strategic partnerships across European markets as AI infrastructure investment accelerates.

articles.title: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
articles.summary: Google expanded its AI storytelling experiment Dreambeans to India with support for 13 local languages, aiming to bring AI-generated personal narratives to a mass audience. The move reflects Big Tech's intensifying push to localize AI applications for high-growth emerging markets.

articles.title: Micron dismisses 4F-squared DRAM as CXMT presses ahead — why Samsung, SK Hynix remain divided
articles.summary: Micron has dismissed 4F-squared DRAM technology even as Chinese chipmaker CXMT pursues it, while Samsung and SK Hynix remain divided on its viability. The debate reflects strategic divergence in next-generation memory chip development as competition intensifies between established players and Chinese entrants.

articles.title: China's memory chipmakers extend their boom into the third quarter as capacity, policy risks build
articles.summary: China's memory chipmakers reported continued growth into the third quarter, even as risks from excess capacity and policy uncertainty mount. The expansion highlights China's determination to achieve semiconductor self-sufficiency despite ongoing geopolitical and economic headwinds.

articles.title: 美团发布全新1. 6 万亿多模态大模型LongCat-2.5：多项智能Agent基准登顶全球第一
articles.summary: Meituan officially launched LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter native multimodal large model designed for long-horizon agentic tasks, claiming top rankings on multiple agent benchmarks. The release demonstrates China's major consumer tech companies investing heavily in frontier foundation models to compete globally.

articles.title: Anthropic Reveals $17 Billion in Revenue as I.P.O. Approaches
articles.summary: Anthropic disclosed quarterly revenue of $17 billion—a 12-fold year-over-year increase—alongside a net loss of $23 billion as the company prepares for an IPO. The figures reveal both explosive commercial growth and the enormous capital burn required to compete at the frontier of AI development.

articles.title: 人只够盯 5 个对话窗口，DeepSeek 让 AI 自己当"大管家"
articles.summary: DeepSeek has proposed a 'Super-agent' architecture using a Router+Worker dual-layer system that hides individual sessions from users, allowing a single agent interface to coordinate multiple background worker agents simultaneously. This addresses a key bottleneck in personal AI agents where humans can only effectively track 3-5 parallel conversation threads.

articles.title: 撑起万亿大模型：华为昇腾 950 超节点斩获世界互联网大会领先科技奖
articles.summary: Huawei's Ascend 950 super-node won a Leading Technology Award at the 2026 World Internet Conference in Wuzhen, recognized among only 20 winners from over 430 nominations across 43 countries. The award signals growing international recognition of China's domestic AI compute infrastructure as a viable alternative to Western chips.

articles.title: 千问办公个人会员月卡登陆李佳琦直播间，半小时售出10万份
articles.summary: Qianwen Office (千问办公) sold 100,000 monthly membership cards within 30 minutes during a live-stream with top Chinese influencer Li Jiaqi, driving approximately 2 trillion tokens of usage. The event marks a significant milestone in the commercialization of large language model applications through mainstream e-commerce channels in China.

articles.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
articles.summary: Anthropic has warned that AI systems are approaching recursive self-improvement (RSI) capability—the threshold at which AI can meaningfully improve its own training process—which the company considers a critical safety inflection point. The warning intensifies debate over AI safety timelines and the urgency of alignment research before such capabilities emerge.

articles.title: Inside Anthropic’s Hunt for A.I. Computing Power
articles.summary: Anthropic has pursued an aggressive series of deals with tech giants and former crypto miners to secure the massive computing infrastructure needed to train and deploy its AI models. The compute acquisition spree underscores how access to processing power has become a critical strategic resource in the AI industry.

articles.title: DeepSeek, Moonshot used OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to train latest models, The Information reports - Reuters
articles.summary: Chinese AI companies DeepSeek and Moonshot reportedly used OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model to help train their latest AI systems, according to The Information. If confirmed, this raises significant concerns about intellectual property, export controls, and the use of frontier US AI models to advance Chinese competitors.

articles.title: Anthropic Taps Macquarie, CommSec for Australia IPO Retail Offer
articles.summary: Anthropic has selected eight financial firms, including Macquarie and CommSec, to manage the Australian retail component of its forthcoming Nasdaq IPO, expected to be one of the largest ever. The move reflects the global investor appetite for AI company listings and Anthropic's strategy to broaden its shareholder base internationally.

articles.title: Anthropic reveals $900bn AI spending commitments ahead of IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic has disclosed $900 billion in AI infrastructure spending commitments ahead of its IPO, with infrastructure costs growing faster than revenues. The revelation raises investor questions about the long-term economics and capital efficiency of frontier AI development.

articles.title: 蚂蚁数科携「智能体超级工厂」亮相香港金融科技周，全新发布KYA方案
articles.summary: Ant Group's digital subsidiary Ant Digital showcased its 'AI Agent Super Factory' platform and a new KYA (Know Your Agent) identity verification solution at Hong Kong Fintech Week 2026. The announcement highlights growing enterprise demand for scalable, secure AI agent deployment in regulated financial services industries.

articles.title: Driven by A.I. Boom, Marvell and Lumentum Announce $115 Billion Merger
articles.summary: Semiconductor and photonics companies Marvell and Lumentum announced a $115 billion merger driven by surging demand for optical networking technology in AI data centers. The deal reflects how the AI boom is reshaping the broader hardware supply chain beyond just GPUs.

articles.title: China's robot makers have mastered the moves. Now comes the race for brains - Reuters
articles.summary: Chinese robotics manufacturers have achieved advanced physical capabilities in their robots but are now competing intensely to develop superior AI 'brains' to make them truly autonomous. This intelligence race is the next critical frontier in China's bid for global robotics leadership.

articles.title: Abu Dhabi's ADNOC, G42 sign deal with OpenAI as Sam Altman travels to UAE - Reuters
articles.summary: Abu Dhabi's ADNOC and G42 signed an AI partnership deal with OpenAI during Sam Altman's visit to the UAE, deepening the Gulf state's ties with leading US AI firms. The agreement highlights the growing geopolitical and commercial importance of Middle Eastern sovereign wealth and energy players in shaping global AI infrastructure.

articles.title: OpenAI Says Former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll to Join Company
articles.summary: OpenAI has hired former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll as a senior counsellor focused on national and cybersecurity modernization. The hire signals OpenAI's accelerating push into the lucrative and strategically sensitive US defense and government AI market.

articles.title: Exclusive: Salesforce Acquires Startup Cresta for $2.7 Billion - The Information
articles.summary: Salesforce has agreed to acquire AI-powered contact center startup Cresta for $2.7 billion, bolstering its enterprise AI and customer service capabilities. The acquisition reflects the rapid consolidation of applied AI startups into major enterprise software platforms.

articles.title: Exclusive: OpenAI Sign Deals With Magnite, PubMatic to Fill Unused ChatGPT Ad Space - The Information
articles.summary: OpenAI has struck deals with ad tech firms Magnite and PubMatic to sell advertising against unused inventory in ChatGPT, marking a significant step toward monetizing its consumer AI platform through ads. This move could reshape digital advertising as AI-native surfaces compete with traditional web and social media channels.

articles.title: 字节跳动扣子宣布企业版宣布下线:11月30日起停止新客购买
articles.summary: ByteDance's AI agent platform Coze (扣子) announced it will phase out and discontinue its enterprise subscription tiers, stopping new purchases from November 30, 2026, and fully sunsetting legacy plans by December 31, 2026. This signals a strategic restructuring of ByteDance's enterprise AI agent offerings amid shifting market dynamics.

articles.title: AI Subscriptions Hit a Wall as Smarter Models Burn Quotas Faster
articles.summary: As frontier AI models become more capable, they consume users' fixed monthly token quotas faster, creating structural tension between flat-fee subscription economics and rapidly improving model performance, as illustrated by Moonshot's Kimi triggering subscriber backlash. This pricing model mismatch poses a significant challenge to sustainable AI subscription business models industry-wide.

articles.title: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
articles.summary: OpenAI appointed Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization to advise on responsible AI deployment for national security, cyber resilience, and allied collaboration. The hire signals OpenAI's deepening engagement with the U.S. national security community as competition over military AI applications intensifies.

articles.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
articles.summary: OpenAI announced its Grid Protectors Program, piloting at a new Georgia data center where it will release up to 1,000 megawatts of power during grid emergencies, equivalent to powering air conditioning for roughly 700,000 homes. The initiative is a strategic effort to counter growing community opposition to energy-intensive AI data centers.

articles.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
articles.summary: Trajectory, a one-year-old startup, raised $45 million at a $300 million valuation to make AI model training accessible to non-technical business users. The funding reflects strong investor appetite for tools that democratize AI development beyond data science specialists.

articles.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
articles.summary: 42AI emerged from stealth with $62.5 million in funding, unveiling a 'world model' it claims can predict human behavior even in novel situations the model has never encountered. If validated, such predictive behavioral AI could have significant implications across advertising, security, and social applications—as well as substantial ethical concerns.

articles.title: Claude’s new rules against game cloning won’t stop the AI copying boom
articles.summary: Anthropic's new Claude policy restricting game cloning is unlikely to meaningfully curb the broader wave of AI-generated copycat apps and games flooding the market. The episode highlights the limits of individual model-maker policies in addressing systemic IP and creative industry challenges posed by generative AI.

articles.title: Law firm's AI use doesn't warrant cutting legal fees, US appeals court rules - Reuters
articles.summary: A US appeals court ruled that a law firm's use of AI does not justify reducing its legal fees, establishing an early precedent on how courts view AI-assisted legal work. The decision is significant for the legal industry and broader questions about how AI productivity gains are valued and compensated.

articles.title: Chinese and Russian AI cyber attacks will be routine by 2028, says GCHQ
articles.summary: GCHQ's National Cyber Security Centre is warning that AI-enabled cyberattacks from China and Russia will become routine by 2028, with current defenses—especially for critical infrastructure—deemed inadequate. The forecast underscores the urgency for governments and industry to upgrade cybersecurity capabilities in the face of state-sponsored AI threats.

articles.title: How Smugglers Get Expensive Memory Chips to China from South Korea - The Information
articles.summary: Smugglers are reportedly moving high-bandwidth memory chips from South Korea to China, circumventing US-led export controls. The revelations highlight the difficulty of enforcing semiconductor restrictions and China's determination to access advanced chips despite geopolitical barriers.

articles.title: DIGITIMES Insight: Intel's retreat from low-margin industrial chips opens edge AI market to AMD and Arm rivals
articles.summary: Intel's withdrawal from low-margin industrial chip segments is creating market openings for AMD and Arm-based competitors in the edge AI space, according to Digitimes analysis. This shift could accelerate the diversification of the edge AI chip ecosystem away from Intel's historical dominance.

articles.title: OpenAI considers rebranding data centers to 'AI compute campuses" as data center backlash intensifies
articles.summary: OpenAI is promoting the term 'AI compute campuses' as a rebranding strategy for its data centers amid growing public backlash over electricity demand, water consumption, pollution, and rising utility costs. This signals that AI infrastructure is becoming a significant political and public relations liability, prompting the company to prepare a coordinated policy push ahead of the 2028 election cycle.

articles.title: 宇树A2夺得登泰山机器人竞速赛冠军，B2负重74公斤获亚军
articles.summary: Unitree Robotics' A2 robot dog won the inaugural CMG World Robot Mount Tai Race, completing a 3.9km course of over 3,100 steps in 43 minutes 41 seconds, while its B2 model carrying 74kg took second place. The competition demonstrates advancing capabilities of legged robots in complex, real-world terrain navigation.

articles.title: LifeVal
articles.summary: OpenAI introduced LifeVal, a new benchmark designed to measure how effectively AI systems help people complete practical everyday tasks such as finding childcare, managing finances, and navigating government paperwork. The benchmark shifts evaluation focus from abstract reasoning to real-world utility and societal impact of AI assistants.

articles.title: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones
articles.summary: Anthropic updated Claude Code's system prompt to explicitly prevent the tool from being used to recreate existing copyrighted video games, amid a surge of AI-generated game clones and decompilations. The policy change reflects growing pressure on AI developers to self-regulate intellectual property misuse before regulatory action.

articles.title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
articles.summary: Agentic AI is being deployed in enterprise analytics to automate workflows, but current systems struggle to generate sufficiently high-quality insights. This quality gap represents a key barrier to realizing the full productivity and decision-making potential of autonomous AI agents in business settings.

articles.title: Coming in 2027: Apple’s $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and switching on lights
articles.summary: Apple is reportedly planning to launch a home robot around 2027, priced at approximately $1,000, with backing from CEO John Ternus but limited initial functionality such as FaceTime support and basic smart-home controls. The move signals Apple's entry into the consumer robotics market, intensifying competition among big tech firms in physical AI products.

articles.title: NVIDIA CEO and Sweden's Technology Leaders Discuss Compute's Next Chapter
articles.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang met with Swedish technology leaders to discuss the future of computing infrastructure, likely including AI data center expansion in the Nordic region. The engagement reflects NVIDIA's ongoing effort to build international partnerships as global demand for AI compute grows.

articles.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
articles.summary: OpenAI engineering team detailed Pando, a custom Git-compatible backend built to handle the massive scale of code development enabled by its Codex AI coding system. The infrastructure investment reflects the operational demands AI-assisted software development places on version control systems at enterprise scale.

articles.title: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex
articles.summary: Qodo integrated its AI code review platform with OpenAI's Codex to incorporate company-specific coding standards and repository context into automated pull request reviews. This application demonstrates how enterprise AI coding tools are moving beyond generic suggestions toward organization-aware, standards-enforcing development assistance.

articles.title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
articles.summary: Elon Musk announced throttling of Grok Bot's usage limits due to unsustainably high operational costs, even as he described it as the fastest-growing product he has ever seen. The move highlights the fundamental economic tension between rapid AI product adoption and the infrastructure costs required to sustain it.

articles.title: Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition
articles.summary: AI infrastructure startup Omen AI acquired water management startup Aquatic Labs for $16 million to integrate liquid cooling expertise into its data center solutions. The deal reflects the growing strategic importance of water and thermal management as AI data centers consume unprecedented amounts of energy and cooling resources.

articles.title: Data centers are now a midterm issue, even in Brooklyn
articles.summary: At a Brooklyn midterm election event, conversations among residents and a local council member repeatedly returned to AI and data centers as salient political concerns, suggesting the technology is becoming a mainstream electoral issue. The shift indicates that AI infrastructure policy is moving beyond tech industry circles into broader civic and political discourse.

articles.title: How A.I. Is Making It Easier Than Ever to Microtarget Voters
articles.summary: AI tools are enabling political campaigns to craft hyper-personalized voter outreach messages at unprecedented scale and precision. This development raises serious concerns about AI-powered disinformation and the integrity of democratic processes.

articles.title: SK Hynix ramps up SOCAMM2 as material shortages push up PCB prices
articles.summary: SK Hynix is ramping up production of SOCAMM2 memory modules as material shortages drive up printed circuit board prices. Supply chain constraints in advanced memory components could create bottlenecks for AI server deployments that depend on high-bandwidth memory.

articles.title: Samsung reportedly in talks with Nidec to develop robot motors
articles.summary: Samsung is reportedly in talks with Japanese motor manufacturer Nidec to co-develop motors for robots, signaling Samsung's ambitions to enter the humanoid and industrial robotics hardware supply chain. The partnership would leverage Nidec's motor expertise alongside Samsung's electronics and AI capabilities.

articles.title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
articles.summary: OpenAI announced increased bug bounty rewards for its security program, adding new bonuses for report quality, researcher loyalty, and priority campaigns to incentivize independent security researchers. The enhanced program reflects growing recognition of external security research as a critical layer of AI system defense.

articles.title: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
articles.summary: OpenAI announced it is conducting its next internal security sprint in partnership with Cathedral Systems, using AI tools to test and harden its own defenses. The initiative highlights the emerging practice of using AI offensively to identify vulnerabilities in AI company infrastructure.

articles.title: 我国 AI 推理数据首超训练：日均词元调用破 175 万亿
articles.summary: China's AI inference data volume has surpassed training data volume for the first time, with daily token calls exceeding 175 trillion, according to CCID Research Institute under China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. This inflection point signals that China's AI industry has shifted from R&D-phase model training to large-scale industrial deployment and real-world application.

articles.title: 美团龙猫发布 LongCat-2.5:1.6万亿参数原生多模态模型
articles.summary: Meituan's LongCat team released LongCat-2.5, a native multimodal model with 1.6 trillion total parameters (approximately 48 billion activated per token), featuring enhanced long-context visual understanding and agent-oriented programming capabilities. This positions Meituan as a serious contender in the large multimodal model space, with the model's weights to be released on GitHub and HuggingFace.

articles.title: Anthropic Revenue Hits Nearly $17 Billion Before Blockbuster IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic reported third-quarter annualized revenue approaching $17 billion, a twelve-fold year-over-year increase, ahead of a potentially record-breaking IPO. The explosive growth highlights surging enterprise demand for Claude and positions Anthropic as a top-tier player in the commercial AI race.

articles.title: 行业首个自进化金融大模型登场：度小满联手港科大发布轩辕4.5
articles.summary: Du Xiaoman Financial, in collaboration with Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and HKGAI, launched Xuanyuan 4.5, a self-evolving financial large model that improves core financial scenario performance by 30% while reducing inference costs to 10% of general models. This represents a significant advance in domain-specific AI for fintech, showcasing productive industry-academia collaboration between mainland China and Hong Kong.

articles.title: DeepSeek 甩出 Super-agent：AI 从"等人派活"变成"自己找活干"
articles.summary: DeepSeek's Harness team published a technical paper and open-sourced a prototype (dsh-superagent-prototype, MIT license) for a 'Super-agent' system capable of autonomously identifying and reproducing software bugs without being explicitly assigned tasks. articles.summary: WIRED identified approximately 400 apps and websites linked to Chinese-language developers that disguise themselves as ordinary AI tools while secretly enabling users to generate violent and sexually abusive deepfake imagery. This exposes critical gaps in app store oversight and highlights the urgent need for stronger AI content safety regulation.

articles.title: ‘Control and sovereignty’ to shape UK approach to AI
articles.summary: The UK government is shaping its AI policy around principles of 'control and sovereignty,' following intense internal debate about how to govern fast-moving AI technology. This signals that the UK intends to take an assertive national stance on AI governance rather than deferring entirely to industry self-regulation.

articles.title: The race to keep AI under control

This political backlash could significantly constrain the expansion of AI compute capacity in the United States.

This clarification is significant as it refocuses the AI infrastructure debate squarely on land-based solutions and their associated regulatory and energy challenges.

articles.summary: Samsung's booming memory business is reshaping how the company allocates capital and investment across its divisions. Strong memory demand driven by AI workloads is giving Samsung's memory unit outsized influence over corporate strategy.

articles.summary: India is accelerating its semiconductor ambitions, with multiple Indian states, chipmakers, and equipment suppliers expanding investments in domestic chip manufacturing. articles.summary: The rise of AI agents is shifting compute procurement logic from solely buying GPU accelerators toward balanced, full-rack server configurations that give CPUs a larger role. articles.summary: Foxconn is negotiating a new partnership with OpenAI and its chairman publicly dismissed fears of an AI bubble. articles.summary: Major tech giants are racing to capture the AI for Science (AI4S) market, with a particular focus on AI-driven drug discovery. This competition signals a strategic pivot toward high-value vertical AI applications with significant scientific and commercial potential.

articles.title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
articles.summary: The Wikimedia Foundation filed a nuanced position in landmark AI copyright cases, supporting LLM training on copyrighted data while opposing chatbots reproducing such content verbatim. articles.title: Murata Invests $6.4 Billion to Double MLCC Output for AI
articles.summary: Murata Manufacturing plans to invest $6.4 billion over five years to more than double production of multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), driven by surging demand from AI data centers. articles.title: Inside the make-or-break AI mega-project behind Nscale’s $35bn IPO
articles.summary: Nvidia-backed neocloud Nscale is pursuing a $35 billion IPO anchored by a large-scale AI data centre campus in West Virginia, despite facing construction delays, local opposition, and financing risks. The project highlights the high-stakes infrastructure bets underpinning AI scaling ambitions and the significant execution risks involved.

articles.title: Newsom special session AI

articles.title: Maine’s data center revolt will decide who controls the Senate
articles.summary: Opposition to AI data centers over environmental concerns—particularly water usage and climate impact—has become a significant issue in Maine's U.S. Senate race. articles.title: Sebastian Thrun Raises $130 Million for AI Engineering Startup Dulo - The Information
